description: Fetch a whitepaper URL (PDF or HTML) and summarize it into one fixed structure: TL;DR, key points, tokenomics, team and risks, in the language asked for (default en). length other than standard is accepted but not applied yet (the answer lists it under ignored_params). Async: returns job_id and status_url; poll get_agent_job. Pro tier.

language.description: Summary language, a two-letter code (default en).

length.description: Accepted, but the summary has one fixed structure (standard); brief and deep are not applied yet.

url.description: Public URL of the whitepaper (PDF or HTML).

name: summarize_whitepaper
